name: interconnect
description: Provides managed connections between your AWS network resources and select partner network resources.

subcommands.name: accept-connection-proposal
subcommands.description: Accepts a connection proposal which was generated at a supported partner's portal.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Initiates the process to create a Connection across the specified Environment.

subcommands.name: delete-connection
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing Connection with the supplied identifier.

subcommands.name: describe-connection-proposal
subcommands.description: Describes the details of a connection proposal generated at a partner's portal.

subcommands.name: get-connection
subcommands.description: Describes the current state of a Connection resource as specified by the identifier.

subcommands.name: list-attach-points
subcommands.description: Lists all Attach Points the caller has access to that are valid for the specified Environment.

subcommands.name: list-connections
subcommands.description: Lists all connection objects to which the caller has access.

subcommands.name: list-environments
subcommands.description: Lists all of the environments that can produce connections that will land in the called AWS region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all current tags on the specified resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add new tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: connection-available
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query connection.state returns available when polling with ``get-connection``.

subcommands.name: connection-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query connection.state returns deleted when polling with ``get-connection``.
